insights.summary: The Salesforce integration stops writing call data to custom objects when fields or picklist values change.
insights.quote: We've got two custom objects for Medicare Advantage dispositions and one for P&C referrals. Those are the ones that go dark.

insights.summary: Finance and procurement push back on paying separately for add-ons (PreSense, QM seats, AI Voice Agent minutes) at renewal.
insights.quote: Finance and procurement are pushing back on paying separately for the add-ons. PreSense, the QM seats, any AI Voice Agent minutes. They want one number.
